record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, construct a fixed item-frequency input feature from training interactions only: c_i=(1+log(1+f_i))^(-0.25), normalized to mean one over observed items and clipped to [0.75,1.25]; use c_i=1 for unseen items. Multiply only each history item embedding contribution by c_i before adding positions. This may reduce dominance of common history items. Persist these scalars for identical inference; retain embedding parameterization, HSTU topology, readout, candidate scoring, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce common history items' input contribution using fixed training-frequency scales, normalized over observed items and clipped to [0.75, 1.25]. Persist scales as checkpoint buffers; the generated predictor imports HSTURec and restores them automatically. Preserve candidate scoring, learned embeddings, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer.
